features.name: Band: Flat 3.2 × 2.4, its shoulders swelling to the head
Basket head: paired claws, two rails
Seat bur, through to the finger, cut at the bench
Drop window, through both side faces along the finger
Array the window down the shoulder
Mirror the first window to the other shoulder
Mirror the array to the other shoulder

field_notes: Lost wax: no undercut anywhere — this pattern would also pull from two-part sand.
Measured with the ring as built: 6 CAD parts (1 joined, 5 cut), 296.7 mm² of part surface; under lost wax they are reported, never gating.
Lost wax: Basket "Basket head: paired claws, two rails" (#3) would undercut a two-part pull over 57.9 mm² (worst -90°) — fine for investment, but this pattern cannot move to sand as-is.

Lost wax: Seat bur "Seat bur, through to the finger, cut at the bench" (#4) would undercut a two-part pull over 25.1 mm² (worst -89°) — fine for investment, but this pattern cannot move to sand as-is.

Lost wax: Piercing "Drop window, through both side faces along the finger" (#5) would undercut a two-part pull over 9.8 mm² (worst -1°) — fine for investment, but this pattern cannot move to sand as-is.
Lost wax: Ring array "Array the window down the shoulder" (#6) would undercut a two-part pull over 18.8 mm² (worst -1°) — fine for investment, but this pattern cannot move to sand as-is.
Lost wax: Mirror "Mirror the first window to the other shoulder" (#7) would undercut a two-part pull over 9.8 mm² (worst -1°) — fine for investment, but this pattern cannot move to sand as-is.
Lost wax: Mirror "Mirror the array to the other shoulder" (#8) would undercut a two-part pull over 18.8 mm² (worst -1°) — fine for investment, but this pattern cannot move to sand as-is.
